PR: Support OTEL_PROPAGATORS to configure tracing propagation [closed; labels kind/enhancement, size/L, area/middleware/tracing]
### What does this PR do?

This PR adds the support of `OTEL_PROPAGATORS` env variable to configure the tracing propagation.
This is based on the [autoprop](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go-contrib/tree/main/propagators/autoprop) propagator from `opentelemetry-contrib`.

### Motivation

Fixes https://github.com/traefik/traefik/issues/10446
